g.text: Automatically improves an AI agent by tuning its harness: the
prompt, model, tools, skills and settings around it.
Task Depot Ops Desk (424242783017) · the only task in this project
Ready 3 run configs · 5 evals the tuner can measure (1 left out)
Kiln can't load eval "Tone (old judge)": its judge model is retired.
The run leaves it out. To use it, fix its judge in Kiln, or update Kiln if
the eval was made with a newer version:
Guidance "Improve refusals and hold placement. Keep the output format."
Enter one model name, with no spaces
Enter keeps opus. sonnet or haiku makes the run cheaper, with weaker plans.
